initial_verifier_errors: The first verifier required exit 0 from git diff --no-index --check. No-index implies an exit-code comparison against the empty file. The call returned exit 1, no stdout, and only the autocrlf warning.

The second verifier disabled autocrlf only for the command. Existing CRLF in implement.md was then reported as trailing whitespace. The final read-only check explicitly recognizes CR at end of line; no artifact line endings were changed.
per_command_git_configuration: Read-only no-index document checks use core.autocrlf=false and core.whitespace with cr-at-eol; no configuration file modified
